name: Name
clientsOwnSpace: Clients see only their own space
dangerBody: Transferring changes who can bill and manage members. Deleting removes its spaces, tasks and channels; reports arriving through its integrations stop being accepted.
onlySuperadminDeletes: Only a platform superadmin can delete an organization
keyShownOnce: This is the only time this key is shown. Save it now.
keyHashOnly: The server keeps a hash of it and nothing else, so it cannot be read back — losing it means rotating and updating whatever was using it.
integrationNamePlaceholder: Name — the client or system this is for
noOriginChecked: No origin is checked — a server sends none. The key is the whole of it.
nothingWired: Nothing is wired to this organization yet.
rotateBody: Whatever is using the old key stops being able to post the moment this happens. You get the new one once.
deleteIntegrationBody: Its channel stops accepting anything. Work already raised through it stays where it is.
revokeBody: They will no longer be able to accept it.
inviteExplain: <1>Add directly</1> assigns the person right away. <3>Invite</3> sends them a request they accept from their own app — no email needed.
meetingsExplain: A meeting reminder rings. At the time you set, everyone in the organization gets a card with a sound — like a call — and a button to join the room if you pick one. The time is kept as a time of day in a zone, so it stays at that hour when the clocks change.
nothingScheduled: Nothing scheduled. A reminder is for the meetings that repeat — the daily, the weekly review — so nobody has to remember them.
pickADay: Pick a day, or it would never come round.
lastDayNote: In shorter months it rings on the last day.
deleteMeetingBody: It stops ringing. Nothing else is affected.
everyoneByDefault: Everyone is included by default, and anyone who joins the organization later is too. Unticking someone is what gets remembered.
lead: Each integration receives reports from an external system, server to server: it holds an ingest key and sends no Origin, so the key is the whole of it. The key is shown once — when it is created, and when it is rotated.
shownOnceShort: shown once, when created or rotated
noOriginsListed: none — nothing can post until one is listed
originNotChecked: not checked; a server sends none. The key is the whole of it.
